editorial.blurb: Chef Xiong brings authentic Szechuan and Chongqing cuisine to Chicago with bold, numbing heat and remarkably generous portions that keep locals and visitors coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Dine in for the freshest, most flavorful experience—Chef Xiong himself periodically greets tables from the kitchen. Try the Chongqing popcorn chicken or Szechuan jelly noodle with black bean sauce for standout dishes that showcase authentic technique.
signatureDishes: Szechuan jelly noodle with black bean sauce
